# Generated by tools/port_damage/generate.py - edit the constants there and re-run.
on_actions = {
	on_capitulation_immediate = { #ROOT is the capitulated country; runs before the engine flips its provinces
		effect = {
			set_country_flag = { flag = MFU_port_damage_skip days = 2 value = 1 }
		}
	}
	on_state_owner_changed = { #ROOT is new owner #FROM is old owner #FROM.FROM is state
		effect = {
			FROM.FROM = { set_state_flag = { flag = MFU_port_damage_skip days = 2 value = 1 } }
		}
	}
	on_daily = { #fires per country; the first one each day runs the global port poll
		effect = {
			set_temp_variable = { MFU_pd_today = global.num_days }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.MFU_pd_day < MFU_pd_today } }
				set_variable = { global.MFU_pd_day = MFU_pd_today }
				MFU_port_poll = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
